PLAN "3-Week Powerlifting Peaking Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "peak for powerlifting meet"

PHASES
  PHASE "Peel & Peak" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Heavy Day - Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          paused_squat 3x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 4x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 75m "Heavy Day - Bench Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 90m "Heavy Day - Deadlift Focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          squat 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Sunday training 30m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          band_pull_or_rows 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Volume Taper - Squat/Deadlift":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 3x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          good_morning 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Volume Taper - Bench":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Speed & Technique":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 6x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 6x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 5x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Sunday training 30m "Mobility & Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3x60..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          quad_stretch 3x60..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Peaking - Light Intensity":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Openers Practice":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x1 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 3x1 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 2x1 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Deload - Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          thoracic_rotation 3x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 3x60..60 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Sunday training 10m "Meet Day":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 1x1 rpe 1 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
